meta.title: Tactical Training
meta.description: TZJ tactical training facilities — forcible entry, indoor CQB, stairwell movement, rope and high-angle scenarios on reconfigurable all-galvanized steel modular systems for law enforcement, SWAT, and military tactical training.

hero.title: Tactical Training
hero.description: Durable steel training structures covering the full tactical spectrum from breach and entry to high-angle rope operations.

scenariosSection.title: Tactical training disciplines
scenariosSection.description: Durable steel training structures covering the full tactical spectrum from breach and entry to high-angle rope operations.

scenarios.title: Breach & Entry
scenarios.desc: Reusable breach training devices and entry doors for rapid forcible entry and interior assault.

scenarios.title: Indoor CQB
scenarios.desc: Reconfigurable interior rooms and corridors for close-quarters combat and room clearing.

scenarios.title: Stairwell Movement
scenarios.desc: Multi-level stairwells and corner structures for vertical movement, cover, and coordinated advance.

scenarios.title: Rope & High Angle
scenarios.desc: High-work and rope descent stations for high-angle approach, rappelling, and high rescue.

modularSection.title: Modular systems that evolve with the mission
modularSection.description: Modular training towers use all-galvanized steel frames with no interior load-bearing walls — high flexibility for indoor tactical training — walls, doors, and windows reconfigure easily. Walls, doors, and windows move, remove, and reconfigure with ease.
modularSection.lead: The same tower can be a multi-room apartment today and an open-plan office or warehouse tomorrow — keeping tactical teams facing new challenges and building adaptability.

customSection.title: Built to your mission requirements
customSection.description: From concept to completion, our consultants and engineers work alongside you to deliver the tactical training facility that best fits your mission.

customPoints.title: Code-ready design
customPoints.desc: Structural design to seismic, wind, and other code requirements for projects across regions and overseas.

customPoints.title: Adapt on demand
customPoints.desc: Design and manufacturing teams build custom layouts, scenarios, and props around mission objectives and progressive difficulty.

customPoints.title: Free reconfiguration
customPoints.desc: All-galvanized steel with no interior load-bearing walls — walls, doors, and windows move freely for unlimited indoor tactical combinations.

customPoints.title: Expandable
customPoints.desc: Add structures as teams grow — introduce advanced disciplines through greater realism and progressive complexity.
